name: momentum-crypto-thresholds-v1
description: Entry/exit threshold sweep for the TSM crypto sleeve (momentum_crypto), pre-registered 2026-08-08 BEFORE any run, in response to the owner's live re-promotion of the sleeve. Hypothesis under test (NOT assumed): the incumbent +5% entry systematically arrives late in 2-3%-magnitude moves and the -2% exit ejects on normal retracement, producing repeated small losses (observed live: USDC sibling sleeve 15 closes / WR 27% / -$271 in 30d; ADA +28.7% captured only in its tail). EVERYTHING except the entryPct/exitPct axis is FROZEN to experiments/momentum-crypto-v1.json: same universe/window (2021-01-01..2026-07-15, asOf pinned), same 3x3 purged folds, same costs, real settled mainnet funding, same BTC buy-and-hold benchmark and the same acceptance gates INCLUDING minExcessReturnVsBench 0 (which the frozen v1 artifact predates — this run is the first crypto run where it binds; gates NOT relaxed). 6 candidates declared up front, none to be trimmed after results: incumbent e5x2 (+5/-2), e3x2 (+3/-2 faster entry), e2x2 (+2/-2 fastest entry), e5x4 (+5/-4 tolerant exit), e3x4 (+3/-4 the combined-hypothesis point), and e8x2 (+8/-2 strictly SLOWER entry — anti-hypothesis control so the sweep does not point only where the hypothesis does). Declared scope cut (before running): exit -6 variants and a full entry x exit grid are omitted to respect the 3-5-variant cap; the legacy 251-trial v7 grid already swept tsmExit -1/-2/-4 and tsmEntry 3/5/8 at slower cadences (240/720/1440min), so this manifest revisits the axis at the production 60min cadence only. priorUniqueTrials=252: the 251 inventoried legacy v7 hypotheses + momentum-crypto-v1's incumbent. The incumbent here is an execution-identity rerun (adds 0 new hypotheses); the 5 variants are new. Inventory incomplete, so complete=false and approval stays blocked by protocol regardless of gates.
